title: How to Download a Complete Copy of Everything Instagram and Facebook Know About You
html:
If you have used Instagram or Facebook for the past five to ten years, Meta knows you with chilling precision. They know which posts you hovered over for 3.2 seconds without liking, every direct message you have ever sent or received, the exact geographic coordinates where you uploaded photos, and which retail companies uploaded your phone number to their custom target lists.

Last updated: 25 Nov 2026. This data privacy tutorial shows you how to request a complete cryptographic export of your Instagram and Facebook account data through Meta Accounts Center, how to unpack the zip archive, and what horrifying information you will find inside.

Under international privacy regulations (GDPR and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act), Meta is legally obligated to hand over every byte of personal data they maintain about you in a standardized, downloadable format. Here is how to request your archive and preserve a lifetime of memories before you ever consider deleting your account.

Step-by-Step: Requesting Your Meta Data Archive

  1. Open Instagram → go to your Profile → tap the hamburger menu (three lines) → tap Accounts Center.
  2. Scroll down to Account settings and tap Your information and permissions.
  3. Tap Download your information.
  4. Tap Download or transfer information.
  5. Choose whether you want data from both Instagram and Facebook, or just your Instagram profile, then tap Next.
  6. Select All available information (or Some of your information if you only want message logs or photos).
  7. Choose Your File Parameters:
    • Format: Choose HTML if you want to view your archive nicely formatted in a web browser like a website. Choose JSON if you are a programmer or want to import the data into local scripts.
    • Media Quality: Select High so that your uploaded photos and videos download at original resolution.
    • Date Range: Change from "Last year" to All time.
  8. Tap Submit request.

Depending on how active your account has been, Meta's servers will take between 30 minutes to 48 hours to compile your zip archive. Once ready, you will receive an email with a secure download link that remains active for 4 days.

What You Will Find Inside the Downloaded Zip File

When you extract the downloaded .zip file onto your computer and open index.html, prepare yourself for an eye-opening audit:

Folder Name What It Actually Contains Privacy Impact
messages/inbox/ Every conversation, voice memo, and shared image ever sent across Instagram DMs and Messenger. Complete communication archive
ads_information/ A list of thousands of third-party companies that uploaded your phone number/email to target you. Reveals which retailers sold your data
location/ GPS coordinates and cell tower timestamps logged whenever you used location tags or camera filters. Historical travel footprint
comments/ & likes/ A searchable record of every comment and like you have made since creating your profile. Psychological engagement profile

Why You Should Back Up Your Data Today

  1. Protect Against Automated Account Bans: Meta's automated AI moderation bots routinely ban accounts without human review due to false-positive copyright claims or compromised account alerts. If your account is disabled, you lose access to all your childhood photos and contacts instantly. Having a local backup guarantees your memories are safe.
  2. Offline Archiving: You can back up the zip file to an external hard drive or private cloud storage (like OneDrive or Proton Drive), completely separating your personal memories from Big Tech servers.
  3. Clean Deletion: If you ever choose to delete your Instagram or Facebook account, downloading your archive first gives you complete peace of mind that you haven't permanently destroyed a decade of creative work.

faq.title: Does downloading my Meta data delete my Instagram or Facebook account?
faq.description: No. Downloading your data simply gives you a local zip file copy of your information. Your active social media profiles remain completely unchanged.

faq.title: How long does Meta take to generate the download link?
faq.description: For small accounts, it usually takes between 30 minutes to 2 hours. For accounts with 10+ years of high-resolution video and photo uploads, it can take up to 48 hours.

faq.title: Can I read my exported messages without internet?
faq.description: Yes. If you choose the HTML format, you can open index.html in any desktop browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) completely offline and browse all your past direct messages.
